plugin.name: Add fight/stop/yield actions
plugin.description: LLM actions Start_Fighting, Stop_Fighting and Stop_Fighting_by_Yielding: NPCs can start a fight, offer a truce, or surrender. Unchecked: these actions are not installed (Torture_Target is always installed).

plugin.name: Show torture overlay
plugin.description: A "Torture Damage" bar per tortured actor (PrismaUI). Unchecked: the dashboard setting "Show torture overlay" defaults to off; it can still be turned on in the SkyrimNet dashboard. A value already saved in the dashboard is kept.
